user_roles_scope_consistency.name: user_roles_scope_consistency
user_roles_scope_consistency.value: ("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'global' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'branch' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

users_email_shape.name: users_email_shape
users_email_shape.value: char_length("users"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320 AND position('@' in "users"."email") > 1

branches_public_address_consistency.name: branches_public_address_consistency
branches_public_address_consistency.value: ("branches"."expose_public_address" = false AND "branches"."address_public" IS NULL) OR ("branches"."expose_public_address" = true AND "branches"."address_public" IS NOT NULL)
